excerpt.rendered: You are God’s poem — His creative handiwork. And the works prepared for you were laid out before you were born. Today’s devotional on Ephesians 2:10 and the purpose hidden in your ordinary day.

content.rendered:
📖 Scripture

“For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.”
— Ephesians 2:10 (NIV)

📝 Message

You are not an accident. You are not filling time. You are not here by coincidence or circumstance. You are God’s handiwork — and there is work that has been prepared specifically, in advance, for you to do.

The word translated “handiwork” in Greek is poiēma — from which we get our English word “poem.” You are God’s poem. You are His creative work, crafted with intention and artistry, expressing something of His character and purpose that no one else in history expresses in exactly the same way.

But Ephesians 2:10 does not stop at identity. It moves immediately to purpose. You were created in Christ Jesus to do good works — works that God prepared in advance. Before you were born. Before you knew what your gifts were. Before you had any idea what your life would look like. God was already laying out the works that would be waiting for you when you arrived.

This means that nothing about your calling is improvised. The conversations you are meant to have, the people you are meant to help, the work your hands are meant to do — these are not random. They are prepared. They have been waiting for you. You do not need to manufacture purpose or engineer significance. You simply need to walk in the direction God is leading, with eyes open to what He has already placed in your path.

The question is not whether there is purpose for your life. There is. The question is whether you are walking in it — or whether you are standing at the edge of it, waiting to feel more ready, more qualified, more certain.

You are God’s poem. Go and live it.

🙏 Prayer

Father, thank You that I am Your handiwork — created with intention and purpose. Open my eyes today to the good works You have prepared for me to walk in. I do not want to miss what You have placed in my path. Make me attentive, obedient, and willing. I want to live the poem You wrote when You made me. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🗣️ Declaration

I am God’s handiwork — His poem, His creative work, made in Christ Jesus. My life has purpose that was prepared before I was born. I walk today into the good works God has already laid out for me. I will not miss them through distraction or fear. My steps are ordered, my purpose is real, and my life is His masterpiece in progress.

📖 Further Reading

  • Ephesians 2:1–10 — Read the full passage: from death to life to purpose
  • Psalm 138:8 — The Lord will fulfil His purpose for me
  • Romans 8:28 — All things work together for good for those called according to His purpose
  • Jeremiah 29:11 — Plans for a future and a hope
  • 1 Corinthians 12:4–7 — Different gifts, same Spirit — given for the common good
  • Matthew 5:16 — Let your light shine before others
